name: Realistic Palo Alto Downtown WGS84 town map sample
description: Textured external 3D town map with ground, roads, sidewalks, lane markings, crosswalks, buildings, cars, trees and street lamps.
source: OpenStreetMap building/highway/park data queried through Overpass API
license: OpenStreetMap data is licensed under ODbL 1.0; credit OpenStreetMap contributors when using derived data. Procedural textures are generated for this QGC sample.
axisConvention: +X east, +Y north, +Z up; local ENU meters from WGS84 origin.
importantNote: This is a generated external OBJ/FBX sample, not a photogrammetry scan or packaged UE5 .umap. FBX/OBJ do not carry portable WGS84 georeferencing; use qgcViewer3DSettings to place it.
